ns2:course.label: Lit and Other Disciplines
ns2:course.description: Advanced topics seminar exploring the intersection of literary study and other scholarly disciplines. The disciplines students study vary each term, but past courses have examined connections between literature and psychology, forensic science, environmental studies, and the law. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. May be repeated with permission of English advising office to a maximum of 6 undergraduate hours if topics vary.May be repeated for graduate credit if topics vary. Prerequisite: One year of college literature or consent of instructor.
